name: Detour Ahead
description: Your normal route is closed ahead and traffic is being sent another way. Slow down and follow the orange detour signs until they lead you back.

name: Flag Person Ahead
description: A worker with a sign or flag is controlling traffic ahead. Slow down, be ready to stop, and do exactly what the flagger signals.

name: Road Closure Ahead
description: The road is closed to through traffic ahead. Start looking now for the detour or another route so you are not forced into a last second turn.

name: Road Crew at Work Ahead
description: People are working on or beside the road ahead. Ease off the gas, give them as much room as you safely can, and stay alert.

name: Work Zone Ahead
description: You are coming into a construction or maintenance area. Slow down, put the phone away, and watch for workers, equipment and lane shifts.

name: Airport Ahead
description: An airport is reachable from this road. Follow the airplane signs to find the right exit or turn.

name: Dynamic Message Sign
description: This electronic sign shows live messages about crashes, closures, travel times or weather. Read it quickly, then adjust your speed or route if it asks you to.

name: Exit Number
description: This number identifies the upcoming highway exit. Know your exit number before you leave so you can move into the correct lane early.

name: Food
description: Places to eat can be found at or near the next exit. Use it to plan a stop when you need a break.

name: Gas Station
description: Fuel is available at or near the next exit. Check your gauge and plan to fill up before you run low.

name: Hospital
description: A hospital with emergency care can be reached by following this sign. Remember it in case you or someone else needs help.

name: Interstate Highway Number
description: This red, white and blue shield shows the number of the interstate you are on or heading toward. Use it to confirm you are on the right route.

name: Lodging
description: Hotels or motels are available at or near the next exit. Plan a stop here if you are getting tired.

name: Rest Area
description: A rest area with parking and restrooms is coming up. If you feel drowsy, pull in and take a break.

name: Rest Area Ahead
description: A rest area is coming up at the distance shown. Plan your stop now and move toward the exit lane in good time.

name: Telephone
description: A public phone is available at or near this location. It can matter on remote roads where cell service is weak.

name: Bicycles Not Allowed
description: Bicycles may not use this road. As a driver you should not expect cyclists here, but stay alert anyway.

name: Bike Lane
description: This lane is set aside for people on bikes. Do not drive or park in it, and check it carefully before you turn across it.

name: Do Not Enter
description: You may not drive past this sign, usually because traffic is coming toward you on a one way road or ramp. Turn around safely.

name: Drive Straight Through the Intersection
description: From this lane you must go straight. Turning left or right here is not allowed.

name: Fines Double in Work Zones
description: Traffic fines are higher in this work zone. Slow down and drive carefully to protect the workers and yourself.

name: Handicapped Parking Zone
description: This space is only for vehicles showing a valid disability placard or plate. Do not park here without one, even for a minute.

name: High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Lane
description: This lane is only for vehicles carrying the minimum number of people shown, plus any other users the sign lists. If you do not qualify, stay out.

name: Keep to the Left of the Traffic Island
image_url: https://ksiqvvoqlzdihjubaxbm.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/flashcards/Keep to the Left of the Traffic Island.avif
description: Pass the island or obstacle on its left side. Steer left of it, not right.

name: Keep to the Right of the Traffic Island
image_url: https://ksiqvvoqlzdihjubaxbm.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/flashcards/Keep to the Right of the Traffic Island.avif
description: Pass the island or obstacle on its right side. Stay to the right of it as you drive by.

name: Left Turn Only
description: Vehicles in this lane must turn left. If you want to go another way, move to a different lane before you get here.

name: Minimum Speed Limit
description: You must not drive slower than this speed when conditions are good. Driving too slowly on a fast road can be as dangerous as speeding.

name: Move Only in the Directions Indicated
description: Each lane must move only the way its arrows point. Pick the lane that matches where you want to go before the intersection.

name: Nighttime Speed Limit
description: This is the top legal speed from sunset to sunrise. After dark, slow to this limit or lower.

name: No Driving on Railroad Tracks
description: Never drive along the rails. Cross railroad tracks only at a marked crossing, and never turn onto them.

name: No Hitchhiking
description: Standing on the road to ask for a ride is not allowed here. As a driver, do not stop to pick up people on this road.

name: No Left Turn
description: You may not turn left here. Go straight or turn right, then find a legal place to change direction.

name: No Parking
description: You may not park here. You can stop briefly to load or unload people if no other signs forbid it.

name: No Parking Between Posted Times
description: Parking is not allowed here during the hours shown. Read the times and days carefully before you leave your vehicle.

name: No Right Turn
description: You may not turn right here. Go straight or turn left if that is allowed.

name: No Standing
description: You may stop here only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers. Do not wait or load goods.

name: No Stopping
description: You may not stop here at all, even briefly, unless traffic or police make you. Keep moving.

name: No Turn on Red
description: You may not turn while the signal is red. Wait for the green light, then turn when the way is clear.

name: No-Passing Zone for All Vehicles
description: This yellow pennant marks where a no passing zone begins. Finish any pass now and do not start a new one.

name: One Way
description: Traffic on this street moves only in the direction of the arrow. Turn so you travel the same way.

name: Only Buses or Carpool Vehicles
description: This lane is reserved for buses and carpools during the times shown. If you do not qualify, keep out of it.

name: Pedestrians Not Allowed
description: People may not walk along or cross the road here. Drivers should still watch for anyone who ignores the sign.

name: Railroad Crossing
description: This white X sign marks the exact spot where the road crosses train tracks. Treat it like a yield sign: slow down, look both ways, and stop if a train is coming.

name: Right Turn
description: This arrow tells you the road or route turns right here. Get into the right position early, signal, and make the turn.

name: Roundabout
description: You are entering a roundabout. Travel counterclockwise to the right, yield to vehicles already circling, and use your signal to exit.

name: Slower Traffic Keep Right
description: If you are driving slower than the traffic around you, use the right lane. Leave the left lane for passing.

name: Speed Limit
description: This is the fastest you may legally drive here in good conditions. In rain, fog or heavy traffic, go slower.

name: Speed Limit Near School
description: A lower speed limit applies in this school zone. Slow down and watch for children walking, biking or crossing.

name: Speed Limit When Children Are Present
description: This lower speed applies whenever children are near the road. Slow down and be ready to stop for a child who darts out.

name: Stop
description: You must come to a full stop at the line, crosswalk or corner. Yield to cross traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

name: Trucks Not Allowed
description: Trucks may not use this road. Other vehicles may continue normally.

name: Turn Left or Go Straight
description: From this lane you may turn left or go straight. Turning right is not allowed.

name: Turn Right or Go Straight
description: From this lane you may turn right or go straight. Turning left is not allowed.

name: U-Turn Not Allowed
description: You may not turn around here. Keep going until you find a place where turning around is legal and safe.

name: U-Turn Only
description: Vehicles in this lane must make a U turn. Move out of the lane early if you plan to go another way.

name: Wear Seat Belt
description: Wearing a seat belt is required by law. Buckle up and make sure every passenger does too.

name: Yield
description: Slow down and give the right of way to traffic and pedestrians. Stop if needed, and go only when it is safe.

name: Yield the Right-of-Way or Stop
description: You must let crossing traffic and pedestrians go first. Slow down, stop if anyone is coming, and continue only when the way is clear.

name: 270-Degree Loop Ahead
description: The road ahead turns in a tight loop, often on a ramp, almost circling back on itself. Slow down before you enter and keep your speed low.

name: Advisory Speed Limit
description: This plaque shows the safest speed for the curve or hazard just ahead. Slow to this speed before you reach it.

name: Bicycle Crossing
description: Bike riders may cross or enter the road ahead. Slow down, look carefully, and give them room.

name: Blind Person Area
description: People who are blind or have low vision may be crossing here. Slow down and be ready to stop for anyone using a white cane or guide dog.

name: Bump on the Road Ahead
description: There is a sharp rise in the road surface ahead. Slow down so the bump does not jolt your car or make you lose control.

name: Cattle Crossing Ahead
description: Cattle may be on or crossing the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Circular Intersection Ahead
description: A roundabout is coming up. Slow down, get ready to yield to vehicles already circling, and pick your lane early.

name: Cross Traffic Ahead
description: Another road crosses yours ahead. Slow down and watch for vehicles coming from the left and right.

name: Curve to the Left Ahead
description: The road bends to the left ahead. Slow down before the curve and keep your car in your lane.

name: Curve to the Right Ahead
description: The road bends to the right ahead. Slow down before the curve and keep your car in your lane.

name: Deer Crossing Ahead
description: Deer often cross here, especially at dawn and dusk. Slow down, scan the roadsides, and expect more than one.

name: Dip on the Road Ahead
description: The road drops into a low spot ahead. Slow down, and watch for water collecting there or for traffic hidden in the dip.

name: Directional Arrow Sign
description: This large arrow warns that the road turns sharply in the direction it points. Slow down and steer through the turn.

name: Divided Highway Ends Ahead
description: The center divider ends ahead and traffic will soon travel both ways on the same road. Keep right and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: Fire Station Nearby
description: Fire trucks may pull out ahead. Watch for flashing lights and be ready to stop and let them go.

name: Freeway Exit Ramp
description: This shows the safe speed for the exit ramp ahead. Slow down on the ramp itself, not on the main road.

name: Hairpin Curve Ahead
description: A very sharp curve turns the road back on itself ahead. Slow way down before you reach it and stay in your lane.

name: Handicapped Crossing
description: People with disabilities often cross here. Slow down and be ready to stop and wait while they cross.

name: Low Ground Clearance Railroad Crossing
description: The railroad crossing ahead is raised and a low vehicle or trailer could get stuck on the tracks. If you are low to the ground, take another route.

name: Main Road Curves to the Left Ahead
image_url: https://ksiqvvoqlzdihjubaxbm.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/flashcards/Main Road Curves to the Left Ahead.avif
description: The road curves left ahead and a side road joins at the curve. Slow down and watch for vehicles entering.

name: Maximum Recommended Safe Speed
description: This is the top safe speed for the ramp or section ahead. Slow to it before you reach that point.

name: Median Ahead
description: A divided highway begins ahead, with a median separating the two directions. Keep right of the divider.

name: Multi-Use Path Crossing Ahead
description: A path used by both walkers and bike riders crosses the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield.

name: Narrow Bridge Ahead
description: The bridge ahead is narrower than the road. Slow down, stay in your lane, and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: Object Marker Sign
description: This striped marker shows an object in or right next to the road, such as a pier or the end of a barrier. Steer clear of it.

name: Overpass Clearance
description: This shows the height under the bridge or structure ahead. If your vehicle or load is taller, find another route.

name: Paved Surface Ends Ahead
description: The pavement ends and the road becomes gravel or dirt ahead. Slow down before the change, since stopping and steering get harder.

name: Pedestrian Crossing Ahead
description: People may be crossing the road ahead. Slow down, watch the roadsides, and be ready to stop for them.

name: Playground Ahead
description: A playground is near the road ahead. Slow down and watch for children who may run into the street.

name: Railroad Crossing Ahead
description: Train tracks cross the road ahead. Slow down, look and listen both ways, and be ready to stop.

name: Railroad Crossing Ahead (Alternate)
description: You are getting close to train tracks. Ease off the gas, turn down distractions, and look and listen both ways so you can stop if a train is near.

name: Right and Left Curves Ahead
description: The road curves right, then left ahead. Slow down before the first curve and keep steady through both.

name: Right Lane Ends Ahead
description: The right lane is ending soon. If you are in it, merge left when there is a safe gap; if you are on the left, let others merge in.

name: Road Shoulder Much Lower Than Road Surface
image_url: https://ksiqvvoqlzdihjubaxbm.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/flashcards/Road shoulder much lower than road surface (1).avif
description: The shoulder drops off well below the pavement. Stay on the road, and if a wheel slips off, slow down gently before steering back.

name: Road Slopes Downhill Ahead
description: A steep downhill grade is ahead. Slow down before the hill and use a lower gear so you do not ride your brakes.

name: Road Turn Ahead
description: The road makes a sharp turn ahead. Slow down well before the turn.

name: School Zone Ahead
description: You are near a school. Slow down and watch for children walking, biking or crossing.

name: Sharp Right Turn Ahead
description: The road turns sharply to the right ahead. Slow down well before you reach the turn.

name: Side Road Near a Crossing Ahead
description: A side road meets your road near a railroad crossing. If you turn onto it, watch for trains and do not stop on the tracks.

name: Slippery Road Ahead
description: The road can be slippery when wet. In rain, slow down, leave more space, and avoid sudden braking or steering.

name: Slow-Moving Equipment
description: Tractors and other slow farm vehicles use this road. Be ready to slow down and pass only when it is legal and safe.

name: Soft Shoulder
description: The ground beside the road is soft and may not hold your vehicle. Stay on the pavement unless it is an emergency.

name: Speed Advisory at Roundabout
description: This shows the safe speed for the roundabout ahead. Slow to it before you enter.

name: Speed Change Ahead
description: A lower speed limit starts ahead. Begin slowing now so you are at the new limit when you reach it.

name: Speed Zone Ahead
description: A reduced speed zone is coming up. Ease off and be at the new limit by the time you enter it.

name: Stop Sign Ahead
description: There is a stop sign ahead that you may not see yet. Get ready to come to a full stop.

name: T-Intersection Ahead
description: Your road ends ahead at a crossroad. Slow down and get ready to turn left or right.

name: Traffic Control Signal Ahead
description: A traffic light is ahead, possibly around a curve. Slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Traffic May Flow on Both Sides
description: You may pass this island or obstacle on either side. Choose the side that fits your route.

name: Traffic Merging Ahead
description: Another lane of traffic joins yours ahead. Watch for merging vehicles and adjust your speed to let them in smoothly.

name: Trucks Entering Highway Ahead
description: Large trucks may enter or cross the road ahead. Slow down and give them room.

name: Two-Way Traffic Ahead
description: You are leaving a one way road and traffic will soon come toward you. Keep right.

name: Upcoming Side Road
description: A side road joins your road ahead. Watch for vehicles entering or turning.

name: Watch for Ice
description: Ice can form on this road, often before you can see it. In cold weather slow down and brake gently.

name: Winding Road
description: Several curves are ahead. Slow down, keep right, and stay in your lane.

name: Y-Intersection Ahead
description: The road splits into two directions ahead. Slow down and pick the branch you need.

name: Yield Sign Ahead
description: A yield sign is ahead. Slow down and get ready to let other traffic go first.
